limitations: Studio desktop/emulator and virtual controller, not physical phone/controller/live multiplayer.
Walking used read-only target solver sending actual WASD. Round used read-only aim solver with actual pointer drops; proves mechanics, not unassisted fun or comprehension.
Prompt native window PNGs include CoreGui; MCP JPGs omit native prompts and do not prove prompt clearance.
Offset diagnostics changed only local prompt offset at fixed camera/root, before matching source literals and fresh scene fixture verification.
LandscapeSensor supports both landscape notch positions, not native portrait play.
A diagonal close table approach auto-stepped onto it; ordinary outside side/rear route returned to floor. Canopy and table collidable policy unchanged.
Native run is isolated Studio store; live-client persistent save/rejoin and audible audio mix remain unverified.
